title: Cross-file match de-duplication with extended-stat merge
evidence: src/data.rs:196-217 Builder::push flags duplicates within 3 days (or same league season) and merges BR-Football corner/shot stats onto the surviving record; tests/bdd.rs:53-61 asserts exactly 380 unique Serie A matches per 20-team season

title: queries.rs is a single 891-line module (maintainability score 0.48)
evidence: src/queries.rs is 891 lines holding filtering, records, standings, head-to-head, players and statistics; scores.json reports maintainability=0.4776
suggestion: Optional: split the player-query and match-query text formatters into submodules; does not affect correctness.

title: data_summary counts Brazilians by exact string, unlike the folded player search
evidence: src/queries.rs:839 uses `p.nationality == "Brazil"` for the summary count, whereas find_players (src/queries.rs:671-674) folds nationality and also accepts 'Brazilian'/'Brasil'; the two paths can disagree if a row stores an accented/variant spelling
suggestion: Reuse the folded-nationality comparison in summary_text for consistency; low impact since the FIFA dataset stores 'Brazil'.
